environment: Local QKI EVM and constant-product pools; no live transactions
tests: explicit 10% sender-tax cap: holder pays 110, first pool receives 100, keeper receives no assets
no extra-tax consent: cap 100 rejects a 110 debit and rolls back balances, allowance, pools and count
tax increases above the holder cap fail before swapping
actual output minimum remains enforced with sender tax
receiver-deducted input tax uses real pool input
output tax is measured at the holder rather than the pool transfer amount
intermediate receiver-deducted tax is handled from actual next-pool input
intermediate sender tax that breaks the pool invariant rolls the complete swap back
funding never uses historical token donations in the helper
designated executor and holder are allowed, other accounts are rejected
only holder can cancel; pause is scoped to that holder
sender-tax token cannot reenter a second order
same-pool cycles are rejected; distinct-pool cycles remain valid
cap-based cumulative budget remains finite across different keepers
allowance must cover sender-paid tax and can be revoked
missing pools, invalid cap and overflowing total budget are rejected
an expired order cannot consume holder tokens
V2 runtime with the real router immutable matches the frontend whitelist
no-return ERC20 input works without any helper-to-router approval
